verdict.rationale: Moss is a semantic search runtime, so reranking is a fair axis to judge it on. The evidence covers hybrid semantic/keyword blending via `alpha`, `min_score` filtering and built-in embedding models, but never mentions a reranking model, built-in or integrated. Hybrid score blending and score thresholds are adjacent features and do not count as reranking.

support.subject: As an ml-engineer, I can rerank search results with built-in or first-party-integrated reranking models
